onboardingWelcomeText: Every day Ruf durch suggests one person you could get in touch with – the more important they are to you, the more often.
onboardingPrivacyText: Everything stays encrypted on your phone. No account, no cloud, no internet permission.
onboardingImportText: Take over contacts from your address book and sort them afterwards. You can add more later.
onboardingImported: {count, plural, =0{No contacts yet} =1{1 contact in the app} other{{count} contacts in the app}}
onboardingNotifyText: At this time the suggestion arrives as a notification – with “Not today”, “Call” and “WhatsApp”.
